::: {.callout-note}
## This page is a scaffold

The CSF filtering analysis is not yet included. This page reserves its place in
the site and defines the questions the eventual report should answer without
presenting unfinished recommendations as established results.
:::

## Planned scope

The guide will document a reproducible, version-aware approach to SOMAmer
filtering for cerebrospinal fluid analyses. It will distinguish assay-level
quality control from study-specific filtering and provide a reason for every
analyte retained or excluded.

Planned topics include:

- the assay version and stable SOMAmer identifiers used for matching;
- matrix suitability and detectability in CSF;
- technical reproducibility and missing or flagged measurements;
- evidence relevant to specificity, cross-reactivity, or off-target binding;
- sensitivity to blood contamination or other pre-analytical factors;
- treatment of duplicate or multiple reagents targeting the same protein;
- sensitivity analyses using broader and narrower SOMAmer sets; and
- an exportable inclusion table with one row per SOMAmer and explicit reason
  codes.

## Proposed reporting pattern

The final report should make attrition visible:

| Stage | Question | Output to retain |
|---|---|---|
| Starting panel | Which assay version and reagents were delivered? | Complete manifest |
| Technical screen | Which measurements fail predefined technical criteria? | Flags and thresholds |
| CSF screen | Which criteria are specific to the CSF matrix or this study? | Evidence and reason codes |
| Analysis set | Which SOMAmers enter the primary analysis? | Versioned inclusion list |
| Sensitivity sets | Do conclusions depend on uncertain exclusions? | Alternate inclusion lists |

::: {.callout-warning}
Plasma-derived filtering rules should not be transferred to CSF without
checking whether their rationale applies to the CSF matrix, assay version, and
scientific question.
:::

## What to add next

When the findings are ready, this page can be expanded with the filtering code,
the source and date of each criterion, an attrition figure, and examples showing
how the choice of SOMAmer set affects downstream results.
